headline.en: Onex fee-generating AUM hits $43.2bn amid active CLO quarter
headline.zh: Onex 收费型 AUM 达 432 亿美元，CLO 业务迎来活跃季度

summary.en: Canadian alternative asset manager Onex reported total fee-generating assets under management of approximately $43.2bn at the end of the second quarter, boosted by collateralised loan obligation activity in its credit business. Onex Credit fee-generating AUM reached $30.6bn, with three CLO transactions adding $1.4bn and structured credit delivering record quarterly fee-related earnings.
summary.zh: 加拿大另类资产管理公司 Onex 公布，第二季度末总收费型资产管理规模（AUM）约为 432 亿美元，受其信贷业务中担保贷款凭证（CLO）活动的推动。Onex Credit 收费型 AUM 达到 306 亿美元，三笔 CLO 交易贡献 14 亿美元，结构化信贷实现创纪录的季度费用相关收益。

headline.en: Homestead holds first close of inaugural agriculture private credit fund
headline.zh: Homestead 首只农业私募信贷基金完成首次募集

summary.en: Farmland investor Homestead Capital announced the first close of its inaugural agriculture private credit fund, anchored by a $150m commitment from the private credit investment team of a large US state pension system. Homestead is targeting a total raise of $350m.
summary.zh: 农田投资机构 Homestead Capital 宣布其首只农业私募信贷基金完成首次募集，锚定投资来自一家美国大型州养老金体系的私募信贷投资团队，金额为 1.5 亿美元。Homestead 的目标总募集规模为 3.5 亿美元。
